This release is corrective: no new player-facing capability, just bugs found while shipping 2.1.0's multi-weapon visibility and RequireCert's certification hook. If you're running 2.1.0 with `MultiWeaponVisibility` on, you were affected by the first one.

## Bug Fixes
- **slung**: stop a concealed or job-hidden weapon from spending a lane, so a visible one no longer gets starved out of the last slot ([Moldrok](https://github.com/MalibuTechTeam/mbt_malisling/commit/f5d2c81a8cd18c45aa766fbbd9d6ae36fcf08515))
- **concealed_carry**: refuse to conceal a weapon whose slot is already hidden by job, instead of reporting a hollow success ([Moldrok](https://github.com/MalibuTechTeam/mbt_malisling/commit/f5d2c81a8cd18c45aa766fbbd9d6ae36fcf08515))
- **low_ready**: drop the chest-carry flag the moment a held weapon becomes suppressed, instead of letting it silently reappear on the chest later with no key press ([Moldrok](https://github.com/MalibuTechTeam/mbt_malisling/commit/f5d2c81a8cd18c45aa766fbbd9d6ae36fcf08515))
- **weapon_rack**: warn at startup when `RequireCert` is set but the certification bridge doesn't exist yet, instead of staying silently inert ([Moldrok](https://github.com/MalibuTechTeam/mbt_malisling/commit/f5d2c81a8cd18c45aa766fbbd9d6ae36fcf08515))

## Performance Improvements
- **core**: skip the scope diff pass entirely when nothing changed, instead of comparing every scope on every 100ms tick regardless of activity ([Moldrok](https://github.com/MalibuTechTeam/mbt_malisling/commit/4e5db93294f6144ddc5549c8b9782ea9bf0f2557))

## Documentation
- collapsed multi-line function docstrings to the house one-line + LuaLS-annotation style across 20 files — bridge/framework detection ([Moldrok](https://github.com/MalibuTechTeam/mbt_malisling/commit/3be6650d9bedbfd7dea57aab86e1256cf2a2e648)), admin dashboard and in-game editors ([Moldrok](https://github.com/MalibuTechTeam/mbt_malisling/commit/8d0beaf733507b3f89dd1382354316121be239a3)), the rest of the module set ([Moldrok](https://github.com/MalibuTechTeam/mbt_malisling/commit/7d9703ee5e94b84cd894dd02180ba2b3abc2874d)), and the original throw logic ([Moldrok](https://github.com/MalibuTechTeam/mbt_malisling/commit/042f9c4a808385243c8bbac2e6a896159dc4b7ee)). Comment-only — no behaviour changed.
